short_description: Our serve-and-return logo on a soft-colored adult unisex tee. 4 colors, XS-3XL, printed when you order. Grown-up sizes only.
long_description:
The Play Before Pixels logo tee is for the grown-ups who sit on the floor, build the tower and wait for the answer.

Our mark is the P of Play. A ball comes back to close it, like the serve and return of talk and play: a grown-up says something, and a child answers. The small gap before the ball is the pause that gives the child a turn. It sits high on the chest, about 10.5 inches wide, in ink with a tomato-red ball, or in white with the same ball on navy.

Choose White, Natural, Mustard or Navy in adult unisex sizes XS to 3XL. Your size and care details are printed inside the neck.

Each tee is printed when you order it by our print partner and shipped to you with tracking, so allow a few extra days before it ships. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

We make grown-up sizes only. We don't make kids' clothing.

Care: machine wash cold, inside out; tumble dry low; don't iron the print.

Looking for a gift? It pairs well with our picture book The Day the Tablet Slept and our 150 "I'm bored!" Play Cards, sold separately.

short_description: "More talk, less tap." in bold type with our tomato-red ball as the period. Adult unisex tee, 4 colors, XS-3XL, printed when you order.
long_description:
This adult unisex tee says "More talk, less tap." It is printed to order for grown-ups, in 4 colors and sizes XS to 3XL. It's a small reminder we wrote for ourselves, printed where we'd see it.

It's about adding, not taking away. One more back-and-forth in the day: a question in the car, a song at the sink, a story at bedtime. It isn't a rule and it isn't a judgment. Every family's day looks different. And a tap on a talking device is talk too.

The two lines are set in our bold display type, about 11 inches wide, with our tomato-red ball as the period and the Play Before Pixels logo underneath. Choose White, Natural or Mustard with ink type, or Navy with white type, in adult unisex sizes XS to 3XL. Your size and care details are printed inside the neck.

Each tee is printed when you order it by our print partner and shipped to you with tracking, so allow a few extra days before it ships. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

We make grown-up sizes only. We don't make kids' clothing.

Care: machine wash cold, inside out; tumble dry low; don't iron the print.

Looking for a gift? It pairs well with our picture book The Day the Tablet Slept and our 150 "I'm bored!" Play Cards, sold separately.

short_description: "Laps not apps." with our tomato-red ball as the period, on a canvas tote for grown-ups. Natural or black. Only inside gift bundles on playbeforepixels.com.
long_description:
The Laps Not Apps tote is a canvas bag for grown-ups, printed to order and sold only inside our gift bundles. Take it on the library run, to the park and everywhere in between. It carries a line we like to keep in mind: laps not apps.

It's a reminder about the best seat in the house for a story, not a rule. It isn't about the talking apps some children use; those are a child's voice. The two lines are set in our bold display type, about 9 inches wide on one side, with our tomato-red ball as the period and the Play Before Pixels logo underneath.

Choose natural canvas with ink type or black with white type.

You'll find it inside our gift bundles on playbeforepixels.com, alongside our tees and digital play kits. Each tote is printed when you order it by our print partner and shipped with tracking, so allow a few extra days.

Made for grown-ups: it's a carry-all bag, not a toy. Keep bags and their handles out of reach of babies and young children.
